prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single finished production sprite atlas for Mark & Bark, a warm children's 2D side-view platform game. A landscape 1536x1024 transparent PNG sprite sheet with exactly 6 separate horizontal landing platforms in two columns, three rows. Each object stays entirely inside its 768x341 cell, with generous empty margins. All platforms have a clearly horizontal, straight walkable top at their upper edge; a shallow front face showing tactile depth. Hand-painted storybook art, warm oak, cream paper, moss, navy and muted gold, rich but clean wood grain, gentle edges, soft left lighting. Row1 left: three stacked school books, navy and moss covers with gold details; right: long yellow pencil bridge tied to two small wooden supports. Row2 left: wooden ruler bridge with small tick marks and brass brackets underneath; right: a pink eraser block with cream-and-navy paper sleeve. Row3 left: low wide spool with colourful thread and flat wooden top; right: a thick oak plank with small brass supporting brackets. Each platform about 650px wide and 130-200px deep inside its cell. True side-view, no perspective sloping landing top. No characters, no labels, no background, no floor, no shadows outside each isolated asset, no overlapping sprites. Genuine alpha transparency.
integration: Native alpha bounds measured individually. Objects cross nominal row cells; no equal-cell sprite cuts are used.
